(hereinafter called the "Contractor/Principal") has submitted a bid vide Tender Reference RFP-132022795 dated 2024-04-02 for the work of Water Treatment Works, and WHEREAS as a condition precedent for the award of the contract, the Contractor is required to furnish a Performance Bank Guarantee for 5% (five percent) of the contract value, and WHEREAS the Contractor has requested Kaveri Mercantile Bank (hereinafter called the "Guarantor") to issue this Performance Bank Guarantee in your favour. NOW THEREFORE, we, Kaveri Mercantile Bank, do hereby irrevocably and unconditionally guarantee to pay to you, on first written demand without protest or demur, an amount not exceeding Rs. 61.15 Lakh (Rupees 61.15 Lakh Only), being Performance Bond amount, subject to the following terms: TERMS AND CONDITIONS Liability: Our total liability under this Bank Guarantee shall not exceed Rs. 61.15 Lakh (India Rupees Rupees 61.15 Lakh Only). Validity: This Guarantee shall remain valid from 2024-04-02 until 2027-10-15 (the "Expiry Date") unless extended by mutual consent in writing. Claim Period: We shall be liable to pay under this guarantee only if a written claim or demand is served upon us on or before the Expiry Date. Enforceability: Any claim arising under this guarantee shall be enforceable at our branch office at Mumbai or at any scheduled bank branch in India as nominated by the claimant. No Defence: Our obligation to pay is absolute and unconditional. We shall have no right of set-off, counterclaim, or defence arising from any dispute between the Contractor and the Employer. Modification: This guarantee shall not be affected by any change in the constitution, ownership, or control of the Contractor or the Employer. Governing Law: This guarantee is governed by the laws of India and is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts in Mumbai.
